SAI_PROFILE_WITH_CORRECT_VALUES.desc: CONFIG SAI_PROFILE TABLE WITH ALL THE CORRECT VALUES

SAI_PROFILE_WITH_INVALID_NAME.desc: Referring invalid SAI_PROFILE key name (lowercase not allowed).

SAI_PROFILE_WITH_MISSING_VALUE.desc: Config SAI_PROFILE entry without mandatory value leaf.

SAI_PROFILE_WITH_RESERVED_NAME.desc: SAI_INIT_CONFIG_FILE is a reserved, structural key and must be rejected.
eStr: SAI_INIT_CONFIG_FILE is a reserved, structural SAI profile key and cannot be set via SAI_PROFILE.

SAI_PROFILE_WITH_NEWLINE_IN_VALUE.desc: A value containing a newline would break the one-entry/one-line KEY=VALUE contract and must be rejected.
